title: One Analysis Measured Sperm Counts Falling By Half
hook: A global analysis found the measured decline speeding up.
closing: The analysis found declines in both concentration and total output, raising questions for future fertility.
question: Should researchers keep tracking this?

segments.say: Average sperm concentration measured 49 million per milliliter, less than half its earlier level in the analysis.
The later period declined 2.64 percent yearly, more than twice the earlier pace.
Total sperm count fell 62 percent in the analysis, extending the pattern beyond concentration.
